code: import api from'../../../services/api';export function getBooks(params){return api.get('/books/',{params});}export function getBook(id){return api.get("/books/".concat(id,"/"));}export function createBook(data,config){return api.post('/books/',data,config);}export function updateBook(id,data,config){return api.put("/books/".concat(id,"/"),data,config);}export function deleteBook(id){return api.delete("/books/".concat(id,"/"));}
